title: MISSED DORTMUND TRAINING, 105M FEE, WORLD CUP HAT-TRICK BY MINUTE 32
description:
Missed Dortmund training. A 105 million base fee from Barcelona. Then a World Cup hat-trick by the 32nd minute.

Dembele missed Dortmund training. Barcelona paid a 105 million base fee anyway. Then came a World Cup hat-trick against Norway by the 32nd minute. Early start, for once.

At the Ballon d'Or he finished seventh, behind Kane, Mbappe and Yamal. Still comfortably ahead of eighth. In the Champions League final he scored the equalising penalty against Arsenal, and PSG won 4-3 on penalties. Barcelona later sold him for 50.4 million. Great business, Barca.

105 million then, 50.4 million later: was Dembele worth it? Verdict below.
